description: This line plot compares the BLEU scores of two decoding strategies—“Consistency: wait-1” and “Inconsistency: wait-9”—under a prefix-constrained decoding setting, as the length of the gold prefix increases from 0 to 20 tokens. The x-axis, labeled “the length of gold prefix,” is linearly scaled with integer tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” ranges from 23 to 29, with major gridlines and tick labels at integer values (23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29). The “Consistency: wait-1” condition is represented by a dashed blue line with open circle markers; it begins at approximately BLEU 24.7 at prefix length 0, dips to ~23.8 at length 1, then rises steadily, reaching ~28.1 at length 20. The “Inconsistency: wait-9” condition is shown with a dashed red line and square markers; it starts at ~25.1, peaks around 26.0 at length 6, then fluctuates between ~25.0 and 25.8 before ending at ~25.9 at length 20. The plot visually demonstrates that the consistent decoding strategy (wait-1) achieves higher and more steadily increasing BLEU scores as the gold prefix lengthens, while the inconsistent strategy (wait-9) shows more volatility and lower overall performance beyond prefix length 5.
